pages.title: Main Page
pages.body: Welcome to **Ashfall**, a city rebuilt on cinders. Start with [[Mira]], [[Theo]], or [[The Lantern Guild]].

pages.title: Mira
pages.body:
---
aliases: [Mi]
categories: [Characters, Archivists]
---

Mira is an archivist who grew up with [[Theo]] in [[Ashfall|the old city]].

## Early life

She learned to read from [[The Archivist]]'s ledgers.

## Personality

Patient, stubborn, and quietly funny.

### Under pressure

She goes still and starts counting exits.

### Habits

She hums while sorting. See [[Theo#Early life|how Theo met her]].

## Relationships

- [[Theo]]: childhood friend
- [[Corin Vale]]: rival
